# The Backrooms

The Backrooms is a free, browser-based first-person survival horror game.

## Play

- [Play the game](https://backrooms.4oli.com/): the live WebGL game and landing page.
- [Repository](https://github.com/martinezharo/backrooms): source code and development scripts.

## About

The maze is procedurally generated in the browser. Players descend through six
levels, manage thirst and equipment, evade entities, find fuses and reach the
exit portal. No download, account or media files are required.
